work in. Our customers, suppliers, company, and community.

well as delivering our products that we have in stock. Keep your operations moving forward by
accessing materials you can use for fabrication.

## Our Products

At Argus Steel, we’re known for five unique products we can deliver within a short time frame. Over
the last four decades, we’ve worked with clients from diverse backgrounds. Whether an assignment
involves shipping out grating for platforms and ramps, perforated sheets for signage, or decorative
wire meshes, Argus Steel is your source for metal products that can be put to the test.

[[perforated metal sheet]][37]

### [Perforated Metals][38]

Perforated metals are appropriate for a wide range of industrial applications. Perforated metal is
particularly well suited for filtration and ventilation procedures.

Argus Steel has many different perforated metal patterns in stock and is able to ship same day in
many instances. These offerings include round hole, slotted, hexagonal, square and decorative
perforations. We have a wide array of gauges, sizes and perforated patterns available, and we can
provide the materials you need without complications.

[[wire mesh grate]][39]

### [Wire Cloth][40]

Argus Steel is a wire mesh distributor with a focus on T304 and T316 stainless steel, plain steel,
aluminum, and may other alloys. We are here to help you with welded wire cloth and woven mesh
products for all applications. Argus Steel also stocks fine wire cloth for filtration and flow
control needs.

Speak to our professionals about industrial wire mesh suitable for all industries.

[[bar grating for sale]][41]

### [Bar Grating][42]

Argus Steel caters to your walkway needs with welded, press-locked, swage-locked, riveted, and FRP
grating materials that can withstand heavy loads. Ideal for use in industrial settings or anywhere a
safe walking surface is required.

Get smooth top, serrated and non-slip grating products from Argus Steel in mill finish, galvanized,
aluminum, and fiberglass. With countless options available in carbon steel, stainless steel,
galvanized steel, aluminum and fiberglass, we are sure to find the material required to meet your
needs. From stair treads to surfaces meeting ADA guidelines, we will meet your needs. Argus Steel
supplies grating materials that require little maintenance and are easy to clean.

[[perforated expanded metal]][43]

### [Expanded Metal][44]

Expanded metal is useful for fabricating industrial structures, walkways and machine guards. You
need an expanded metal distributor who offers a full array of products. Argus Steel carries expanded
metal products from micomesh expanded metal up to heavy duty catwalk grating.

Expanded metal from Argus Steel offers an outstanding strength-to-weight ratio for your industrial
operations.

[[safety plank grating]][45]

At Clamason, we help industry leaders to innovate and develop through exceptionally manufactured
components. To achieve this, we partner with global customers to support projects of all sizes, from
prototype to production. Using our many years of design and metal pressing engineering experience,
our engineers are extremely creative during the product design engineering process, always looking

## Devchhaya Group Of Industries

##### Leading Sheet Metal Presses Components Provider Since 1990

Welcome to Devchhaya Group Of Industries! We are a leading manufacturer, exporter, and supplier of a
wide range of high-quality Sheet metal stampings and assemblies, Sheet metal pressed parts and
assemblies, Sheet metal automotive components, sheet metal Pressing, stampings, welding and
fabrication components press tools, press components, Steel stampings, pressing , fabrication and
tubular components, Engineering metal stampings, fabrication and tubular assemblies in Pune,
Maharashtra, India.
The company was established in the year 1990 and initially started as a job worker of sheet shearing
for Tata Motor's vendors with a single shearing machine. Over the years, Devchhaya Industries has
grown to become a major vendor for some of the world's most recognized and India's largest
automobile companies, including Tata Motors. The company currently has a strength of 440+ employees
and is a group company of 5 major units, equipped with advanced manufacturing machinery and
infrastructure.

##### Announcement

We are proud to announce a major milestone in the journey of Devchhaya Industries—the establishment
of a new manufacturing plant as part of our strategic expansion plan. This development reaffirms our
commitment to innovation, capacity growth, and serving the Indian automobile and fabrication sectors
with unmatched quality and reliability.
Our new plant is expected to be ready by this year end.

###### Facilities at our new plant:
* We are adding 250 ton, 350 ton and 500 ton presses (one each)
* Laser cutting machine 1500×3000 6KW
* Press brake (CNC)
* Welding machines
* Other auxiliary machine and facilities

# Custom Metal Stamping Solutions for Your Most Complex Needs

When you require the production of precision metal parts and assemblies, we're the custom metal
stamping manufacturer you can turn to for excellence. Every time.

## Metal Forming, Redefined

For more than a century, the metal-forming experts at Falls Stamping & Welding have met the dynamic
needs of our customers, building long-lasting relationships through a commitment to precision,
quality, and service. We specialize in short- and long-run metal stamping and fabrication, and
assemblies, delivering [solutions that go beyond the capabilities of traditional manufacturers][25].

Everything we produce is proudly made in the USA, with a focus on precision and quality across a
range of materials, including.
* Stainless steel
* Hot and cold rolled steel
* Aluminum
* Galvanized metal

We also supply stainless and carbon steel exhaust and tank straps to the heavy-duty truck and
automotive sector. We can do this because we excel at manufacturing complex stampings and assemblies
that don’t lend themselves to automation due to design and volume constraints.

[metal stamped parts ]

## Our Core Services

Our presses, ranging from 100 to 900 tons, enable us to produce a wide variety of parts, from
intricate components to larger assemblies. We're also IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 14001:2015 certified
to work in many industries.

We specialize in custom, complex metal stampings that others find challenging, including those that
defy automation and require high touch.

in tackling tight tolerances, complex geometries and challenging projects.

Expertise Sectorielle

## Une présence forte dans les industries clés

Le Groupe Filame travaille de l’unité à la grande série pour l’industrie en général, avec un savoir
faire spécifique dans plusieurs industries clés. Le top 10 de nos clients est composé de leaders

Matières & Finitions

## Maîtrise des alliages haute performance

Filame travaille une vaste gamme de métaux, des aciers ressorts classiques aux alliages les plus
complexes comme l’Inconel, l’Hastelloy ou l’Elgiloy. Nous assurons également des traitements de
surface techniques répondant aux normes industrielles les plus strictes.

[Découvrir nos matières][123]

Innovation & Infrastructure

## Machines, automatisation et énergie verte

Filame investit en continu dans des machines CNC suisses, allemandes, italiennes et japonaises.
Grâce à une automatisation poussée — 250 machines opérées par 35 ouvriers — et à ses propres
panneaux solaires, Filame vise l’autonomie énergétique complète.

[Découvrir notre technologie][124]
[Innovation Technologique]

### Le fonds européen de développement régional et la Wallonie investissent dans votre avenir

Filame Brussels a sollicité de la Région Wallonne l’obtention d’une prime à l’investissement dans le
cadre d’un programme d’investissements: la construction d’un hall de production de 3500 M2, achat
d’une machine électroérosion, achats de matériel d’exploitation générant un accroissement d’emploi
nouveau.

Filame travaille une vaste gamme de métaux, des aciers ressorts classiques aux alliages les plus
complexes comme l’Inconel, l’Hastelloy ou l’Elgiloy. Nous assurons également des traitements de
surface techniques répondant aux normes industrielles les plus strictes.

Innovation & Infrastructure

## Machines, automatisation et énergie verte

Filame investit en continu dans des machines CNC suisses, allemandes, italiennes et japonaises.
Grâce à une automatisation poussée — 250 machines opérées par 35 ouvriers — et à ses propres
panneaux solaires, Filame vise l’autonomie énergétique complète.

nouveau.

# Custom Metal Stamping at G&M

Welcome to G&M Manufacturing Corporation, your premier partner in precision metal stamping and
busbar manufacturing, serving a diverse range of industries since 1967.

[Ready to elevate your project? Get in touch with us today!][36]
[hero-product-image-1]


## About Us

### Company Overview

Founded in 1967 and located in the Northwest Suburbs of Chicago, G&M Manufacturing Corporation is a
testament to the metal stamping industry by providing products with quality and reliability that can
withstand the test of time.

We are proud to be a stable, long-term supplier with a loyal, non-unionized workforce. Because of
our extensive experience processing various types of materials, we are able to meet our customers’
complex needs with precision and efficiency, ensuring perfect results in every project.

### Mission and Vision

At G&M, our mission is to achieve the highest possible level of customer satisfaction through
designing and implementing manufacturing processes that meet the highest quality and output. We
strive to become the leading metal stamping manufacturer and offerers of custom precision metal
stamping, continually improving our processes to minimize long-term costs and maximize performance.
We are dedicated to innovation and excellence, making us your ideal partner for high-quality metal
components.

Our Services

## Precision Metal Stamping at G&M

With presses of up to 100 tons in an ISO 9001:2015-certified facility, G&M Manufacturing ensures
precision in all its precision metal stamping. Many of our presses are equipped with in-die sensors
and automated camera systems to ensure the best standard of quality. We work with a variety of
materials, including copper alloys, stainless steel, high and low-carbon steels, aluminum, and many
clad materials.

Our stampings range from intricate lead frames and springs to connectors and brackets, all meeting
the stringent demands of industries like automotive, electronics, and medical. Thanks to our
expertise, we can handle complex product shapes and patterns, providing consistently reliable parts
for any application.

[Learn more][37]
 
Our Services

## Busbar Manufacturing

At G&M, a core area of our business is the production of high-quality busbars—an indispensable
component for effective energy distribution in many electrical applications. Our capability in
precision metal stamping makes it possible for us to be excellent busbar manufacturers.

Our busbars are designed with aluminum and copper, both known for their conductive nature and
performance within electrical systems. We also plate them in tin, silver, or nickel to improve their
durability and corrosion resistance. In any case, our products provide optimal safety and efficiency
when it comes to delivering power to vehicles, switch gears, and electronic devices. Choosing G&M as
your busbar manufacturer is a guarantee that you will benefit from our industry expertise, our
commitment to quality, and our capability to provide precise tailored solutions that meet the needs
of your operations.

[Learn more][38]

## Featured Stamping Projects

At G&M Manufacturing, we handle a broad spectrum of stamping projects, demonstrating our versatility
across multiple industries. From intricate automotive components to robust industrial machinery
parts, our custom precision metal stamping and busbar manufacturing capabilities enable us to tackle
challenges and deliver precision-engineered solutions.

### [Forming Die Manufacturer with In-House Tool Making Capabilities| HENSA][22]

[Learn More][23]

Accurate, reliable components require properly designed, precisely built dies. Assemblies that meet
100% as-specified standards require exacting fixtures. Our tooling is conceived with the finished
product use in mind. After we engineer, design, model, and build these precise dies and fixtures,
our specialists will regularly inspect, repair as needed, and re-certify all tooling after every
production cycle.

[Full-Service Metal Stamping][Full-Service Metal Stamping]

### [Full-Service Metal Stamping][24]

[Learn More][25]

At HENSA, we blank, punch, pierce, extrude, fold, draw, and cut-to-length a wide range of sizes and
materials with our stamping presses. We regularly work with carbon steel, stainless, galvanized,
galvannealed, aluminum, brass, and copper. We utilize 14 stamping presses and five coil feed lines
to produce up to 3/8” thick continuously, 3/4” thick by unit, and 3/8” thick progressively.

[Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly]

### [Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][26]

[Learn More][27]

Through the process of metal fabrication, HENSA is capable of building parts, components, weldments,
or complete assemblies from coil, sheet, bar stock, tubing, or plate. We regularly work with a broad
range of materials, from carbon and stainless steel to aluminum and beyond. We also work with a
number of exotic alloys. In their raw form, we regularly work with thicknesses from .02” up to 3/4”.

[Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][Kit Packaging Solutions &
Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly]

### [Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][28]

[Learn More][29]

In conjunction with your packaging requirements, HENSA offers full assembly and kitting services.
HENSA often assembles kits for construction job sites in order to simplify field erection and
building construction. Years of industry experience have united us with some of the country’s best
packaging suppliers, allowing customers to enjoy our discounted supply rates.

[High-Quality Metal Finishing][High-Quality Metal Finishing]

### [High-Quality Metal Finishing][30]

[Learn More][31]

High-quality finishing for metal stampings extends the versatility of metal parts for both
decorative and protective purposes. It can also be used to enhance electrical conductivity and
solderability. HENSA offers treatments capable of meeting our customers’ specific requirements,
which can often include inspection methods, environmental regulations, and cosmetic criteria such as
color, gloss, texture, thickness, and other specialty features.

### [Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][26]

[Learn More][27]

Through the process of metal fabrication, HENSA is capable of building parts, components, weldments,
or complete assemblies from coil, sheet, bar stock, tubing, or plate. We regularly work with a broad
range of materials, from carbon and stainless steel to aluminum and beyond. We also work with a
number of exotic alloys. In their raw form, we regularly work with thicknesses from .02” up to 3/4”.

[Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][Kit Packaging Solutions &
Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly]

### [Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][28]

[Learn More][29]

In conjunction with your packaging requirements, HENSA offers full assembly and kitting services.
HENSA often assembles kits for construction job sites in order to simplify field erection and
building construction. Years of industry experience have united us with some of the country’s best
packaging suppliers, allowing customers to enjoy our discounted supply rates.

[High-Quality Metal Finishing][High-Quality Metal Finishing]

### [High-Quality Metal Finishing][30]

[Learn More][31]

High-quality finishing for metal stampings extends the versatility of metal parts for both
decorative and protective purposes. It can also be used to enhance electrical conductivity and
solderability. HENSA offers treatments capable of meeting our customers’ specific requirements,
which can often include inspection methods, environmental regulations, and cosmetic criteria such as
color, gloss, texture, thickness, and other specialty features.

## [Frequently Asked Questions][74]

Click any question to expand — quick answers about our precision mold & stamping services

What is the typical lead time for a custom injection mold?

+

15-25 working days for standard precision molds (1-8 cavities). Complex multi-cavity or high-speed
stamping dies: 30-40 days. Expedited 7-15 day service available for urgent projects.

What precision tolerance can you achieve?

+

Plastic injection molds: ±0.005mm to ±0.01mm. Metal stamping parts: ±0.01mm to ±0.03mm. Precision
machining: ±0.002mm with Sodick wire EDM and Makino CNC equipment.

What materials do you work with?

+

Engineering plastics: LCP, PBT, PA66, PA6, PPS, PC/ABS, POM, ABS, PP, PE, TPU, TPE (Sabic, Dupont,
Celanese, BASF, LG Chem). Metals: Phosphor bronze, Brass, Beryllium copper, Stainless steel, CRS,
Aluminum.

Do you provide design support and DFM reports?

+

Yes, free DFM reporting included with every mold project. Within 24 hours of receiving your 3D CAD
file, our team provides analysis on draft angles, wall thickness, gate location, weld lines,
ejection design, and cost-saving suggestions.

What is your typical mold life expectancy?

+

Standard prototype: 10k-50k shots. Production molds (P20, 718H): 300k-500k shots. High-volume
hardened steel (S136, H13, D2): 1,000,000+ shots. Maintenance guidelines and spare parts
recommendations provided.

Do you offer prototyping before mass production?

+

Yes — three options: 1) Soft tooling / bridge molds for 500-5,000 samples (10-15 days). 2) 3D
printed SLA/SLS prototypes (3-5 days). 3) CNC machined prototypes from actual production materials
for functional testing.

What file formats do you accept for quotes?

+

2D: PDF, DWG, DXF. 3D: STEP (.stp, .step), IGES (.igs), SolidWorks (.sldprt), Parasolid (.x_t), STL,
Pro/E (.prt). Most quotes returned within 24 hours.

How do I get a quote? What information do you need?

+

Submit your inquiry via our contact form or email lishao@dgqrdz.cn. Please provide: 2D/3D CAD file,
material specification, annual quantity, target dimensions, tolerance requirements, and surface
finish needs.

stamping dies: 30-40 days. Expedited 7-15 day service available for urgent projects.

What precision tolerance can you achieve?

Do you provide design support and DFM reports?

file, our team provides analysis on draft angles, wall thickness, gate location, weld lines,
ejection design, and cost-saving suggestions.

+

Standard prototype: 10k-50k shots. Production molds (P20, 718H): 300k-500k shots. High-volume
hardened steel (S136, H13, D2): 1,000,000+ shots. Maintenance guidelines and spare parts
recommendations provided.

for functional testing.

# Your Domestic Supply Chain Partner.

## Dedicated to Your Manufacturing Success

Kapco Metal Stamping is committed to high-quality contract manufacturing with a dedicated and
skilled team driven by our customers’ success.

With decades of experience and a commitment to innovative solutions, we proudly serve some of the
world’s biggest brands across multiple industries to make the precision metal parts that bring their
products to life.

[Discover what Kapco can do][30]

**GROWTH & OPPORTUNITY**

## Join Team Kapco to help power, feed, and defend the world.

At Kapco, our incredible team is responsible for the manufacturing of critical components for some
of the world’s biggest brands. Our products help defend our nation, feed people around the globe,
light stadiums and communities, and make our world better and more sustainable.

Kapco is home to more than 500 team members across eight facilities who live by our Core Values.
With robust benefit packages, amazing community engagement opportunities, and an unrelenting
commitment to both professional and personal growth through ongoing training and enrichment, Kapco
is Wisconsin’s choice for discovering careers in manufacturing.

[Apply Today][31]

# Metal forming machines
# innovation and precision by LEIFELD

Metal forming is a key technology that significantly determines the development and performance of
our modern industry. From the automotive industry to hydrogen applications, lighting, wind energy,
oil & gas, food & chemical industry and aerospace – components manufactured by metal forming
machines can be found everywhere. In this demanding field, Leifeld Metal Spinning GmbH has
established itself as one of the leading machine tool manufacturers in special machine construction
with the LEIFELD and NIHON SPINDLE brands. **With over 130 years of experience** and team members
worldwide, we develop individual solutions for chipless metal forming in your industry!

[ Über uns ][97]
[ Lösungen ][98]
[Machine in factory environment]

## What are flow forming machines?

Metal fabrication tools such as **spinning and flow forming machines** form metals **without
cutting, i.e. without material loss**. In contrast to machining processes (e.g. milling or turning),
that produce chips, the metal is permanently **deformed by targeted pressure **during chipless
forming – for example in the form of a round blank or a preform that forms the desired contour when
rotated around a forming mandrel. The material therefore flows under force along a predetermined
shape – **precisely, efficiently and gently**. Depending on the metal forming process, **heat and
special tools** are also used to optimize the forming behavior. This results in rotationally
symmetrical components made from a wide variety of materials ideal for applications with special
requirements in terms of dimensional accuracy, weight, stability and cost-effectiveness.

As an internationally experienced manufacturer of metal forming machines, we at **LEIFELD **have
been developing and manufacturing **innovative and application-specific solutions **that set
standards worldwide since 1891. You too can rely on our expertise in metal forming machinery!

# Metal forming machines
# innovation and precision by LEIFELD

Metal forming is a key technology that significantly determines the development and performance of
our modern industry. From the automotive industry to hydrogen applications, lighting, wind energy,
oil & gas, food & chemical industry and aerospace – components manufactured by metal forming
machines can be found everywhere. In this demanding field, Leifeld Metal Spinning GmbH has
established itself as one of the leading machine tool manufacturers in special machine construction
with the LEIFELD and NIHON SPINDLE brands. **With over 130 years of experience** and team members
worldwide, we develop individual solutions for chipless metal forming in your industry!

[ Über uns ][97]
[ Lösungen ][98]
[Machine in factory environment]

## What are flow forming machines?

Metal fabrication tools such as **spinning and flow forming machines** form metals **without
cutting, i.e. without material loss**. In contrast to machining processes (e.g. milling or turning),
that produce chips, the metal is permanently **deformed by targeted pressure **during chipless
forming – for example in the form of a round blank or a preform that forms the desired contour when
rotated around a forming mandrel. The material therefore flows under force along a predetermined
shape – **precisely, efficiently and gently**. Depending on the metal forming process, **heat and
special tools** are also used to optimize the forming behavior. This results in rotationally
symmetrical components made from a wide variety of materials ideal for applications with special
requirements in terms of dimensional accuracy, weight, stability and cost-effectiveness.

As an internationally experienced manufacturer of metal forming machines, we at **LEIFELD **have
been developing and manufacturing **innovative and application-specific solutions **that set
standards worldwide since 1891. You too can rely on our expertise in metal forming machinery!

like Inconel 718 to achieve flawless micro-features and flawless internal surfaces—delivering
reliable, high-performance components for critical aerospace fuel systems.

facility and spoke with COO Louise Slade about how an ambitious subsea habitat programme created one
of the largest wire-arc DED operations.

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

# American-Made Metal Stamping Manufacturer

Oneda Corporation is a Georgia-based, family-owned, contract precision metal stamping manufacturer.
For more than 60 years, our team of highly skilled tool and die shop makers have been producing
on-time, high quality products for our customers. Our manufacturing facility in Columbus, Georgia is
[ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and IATF 16949:2016 certified][30].

## Automotive/Heavy Truck Specialists

# WE Make Metal Stamping
# & Welded Assemblies

## Manufacturing Quality Parts Since 1969

## Why Choose Orick Stamping?

With the use of advanced leadership techniques and teamwork we strive to meet customer
expectations.  Our goal is to deliver total customer satisfaction through total quality culture. 
Our various capabilities and products include stamping, assembly, and multiple welding processes. 
Allow us to demonstrate what sets us aside from the competition.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_009-1-1024x686-1.jpg]

## Metal Stamping

A wide range of stamping capabilities makes us an ideal candidate for all stamped components.  Our
standard stampings include drawn cups, outer metal bushings, center bearing brackets, and varying
styles of brackets and plates for suspension, sub-frame, and other driveline components.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_047-1024x684-1.jpg]

## Welding & Assembly

Utilization of state-of-the-art controls, integrated systems, and robotics to MIG Weld and
Resistance Weld stamped and purchased components.  We also offer a range of robust and error proofed
assembly operations including press type staking of fasteners and components, plastic heat staking,
and rubber insert assembly.  We are always up for new and challenging assembly operations to add to
our growing capabilities.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_022-1024x683-1.jpg]

## Industry

Our main focus has been the Automotive Industry and mainly NVH/anti-vibration components for the
Tier 1 customer base.  We have also served the Heavy Truck, Appliance, and Agricultural Industries
and are always looking for the next industry we can support to add to our growing portfolio.

## Automotive/Heavy Truck Specialists

# WE Make Metal Stamping
# & Welded Assemblies

## Manufacturing Quality Parts Since 1969

## Why Choose Orick Stamping?

With the use of advanced leadership techniques and teamwork we strive to meet customer
expectations.  Our goal is to deliver total customer satisfaction through total quality culture. 
Our various capabilities and products include stamping, assembly, and multiple welding processes. 
Allow us to demonstrate what sets us aside from the competition.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_009-1-1024x686-1.jpg]

## Metal Stamping

A wide range of stamping capabilities makes us an ideal candidate for all stamped components.  Our
standard stampings include drawn cups, outer metal bushings, center bearing brackets, and varying
styles of brackets and plates for suspension, sub-frame, and other driveline components.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_047-1024x684-1.jpg]

## Welding & Assembly

Utilization of state-of-the-art controls, integrated systems, and robotics to MIG Weld and
Resistance Weld stamped and purchased components.  We also offer a range of robust and error proofed
assembly operations including press type staking of fasteners and components, plastic heat staking,
and rubber insert assembly.  We are always up for new and challenging assembly operations to add to
our growing capabilities.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_022-1024x683-1.jpg]

## Industry

Our main focus has been the Automotive Industry and mainly NVH/anti-vibration components for the
Tier 1 customer base.  We have also served the Heavy Truck, Appliance, and Agricultural Industries
and are always looking for the next industry we can support to add to our growing portfolio.

## Frequently Asked
## Questions

What are seed words?

Also known as a recovery phrase (or simply “seed”), it’s a list of words in a specific order that
contains everything needed to restore your wallet. It’s typically generated automatically by a
hardware wallet (such as Ledger, Trezor, or Coldcard) and usually consists of 12–24 words.

Does it support 12- and 24-word seed phrases?

Yes. We offer different plate options for both 12- and 24-word setups. You choose your preferred
format when selecting your kit.

How long does it take?

Typically 30–60 minutes, depending on the number of words and your pace.

Vacuum die casting significantly enhances overall part integrity by reducing harmful gas porosity

machining, or strict porosity control, especially in sealing or safety-critical applications.

shrinkage. This process helps us deliver aluminum parts with higher precision, better strength, and
greater consistency. It is well suited for complex components in robotics and medical devices.

# Progressive Die Metal Stamping Manufacturer

High-volume production stampings (50,000+ parts/year) and fabricated aluminum extrusions — with
secondary operations and assembly under one roof.

We help OEMs simplify their supply chain by producing finished stamped and extruded components, not
just parts that still need work.

[ Send Us Your Print / RFQ ][47]
[Talan Products Feature Image]

## Built for High-Volume, Long-Term Programs

Talan Products specializes in progressive die metal stamping for repeat production programs where
consistency, quality, and scale matter. For customers that also require aluminum components, we
fabricate aluminum extrusions with precision secondary operations, allowing you to reduce vendors,
lead times, and total cost.

We’re not a job shop — we’re a high-volume manufacturing partner.

** 30 ** + Years Of Experience
[Talan Products Feature Image] [Talan Products Feature Image]

## Capabilities at a Glance

### Progressive die metal stamping

for 50,000+ parts per year production programs

### Fabricated aluminum extrusions

for 50,000+ parts per year production programs

### Single-source supplier

for stamped and extruded components

### Materials

steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper alloys

### Secondary operations

piercing, tapping, cut-to-length, welding, and assembly

### Domestic manufacturing

with Design for Manufacturability (DFM) support

## We Do the Next Step

Many suppliers stop at stamping or extrusion. We don’t. Talan Products is built around doing the
next step — the fabrication and assembly work that turns parts into ready-to-use components.

[Talan Products Feature Image]

### Precision hole patterns and cut-to-length aluminum extrusions

[Talan Products Feature Image]

### Tapped, formed, and welded stampings

[Talan Products Feature Image]

### Sub-assemblies, kits, and finished components ready for installation

For our customers, this means fewer suppliers, fewer handoffs, and fewer problems.

## High-Volume Stamping, Aluminum Fabrication & Assembly Solutions

Progressive Die Metal Stamping (Our Core)
We specialize in progressive die metal stamping for OEMs that require:
* High-volume, repeatable production
* Tight tolerances and long-term consistency
* High-volume, repeatable production
* High-volume, repeatable production

Our engineering team works closely with customers on DFM and early supplier involvement, helping
ensure your part is designed for manufacturability before tooling is built.

Fabricated Aluminum Extrusions (More Than Mill Supply)
Our extrusion capabilities are ideal for programs that require:
* Evenly spaced or complex hole patterns
* Precision cut-to-length profiles
* Secondary machining and tapping
* Assembly into finished components

Whether your program ships by the pallet or by the truckload, we support high-volume aluminum
extrusion fabrication with the same production mindset as our stamping operations.

[FAQ Feature Image]

### We’re a good fit if you need:
* Progressive die stamping for 50,000+ parts per year

* A supplier that handles secondary operations and assembly
* A domestic manufacturing partner focused on quality and reliability

[Feature Image]

* Short-run job shop work

Manufacturers that need durable, repeatable, and cost-effective components often turn to transfer
press stamping for high-volume production. This metal forming process is widely used to create

industries, from the automotive giants to those focused on alternative energy, rely on this trusted
process to produce durable, high-precision components. As a global metal stamping manufacturer, we
know that getting the design right means understanding how material, geometry, and process variables
all interact.

# Precision Metals Solutions for Your Most Challenging Applications

Ulbrich delivers custom-engineered strip, foil, and precision wire for critical applications across
aerospace, medical, automotive, industrial, and other demanding markets. With tight tolerances,
reliable supply, and metallurgical support, we help manufacturers reduce risk, improve performance,
and build with confidence.

[

#### Strip & Foil

Re-roller and distributor of over 100 alloys of precision strip and foil including stainless steel,
titanium, nickel alloy and cobalt alloy.

View Product
][200] [

#### Shaped Wire

Shaped Wire is produced to exacting cross-sectional dimensions in our dedicated shaped wire
facility. Shaped profile wire minimizes or eliminates costly machining by being net, or near net, in
shape.

View Product
][201] [

#### Fine & Flat Wire

Custom engineered precision wire products including; Fine Wire, Round Wire, Flat Wire, and Shaped
Profiles.

## Inside the Engine

URLert is an orchestrated system of specialized AI agents.

### Domain Intelligence

Before scanning content, we analyze the domain. We check for **Typosquatting** (e.g., `paypa1.com`),
domain age, and high-risk TLDs to catch attacks before they even load.

Typosquat Detection Newly Registered Domain

### The Orchestrator

Our "Fail-Fast" engine. If the domain is obviously malicious, we stop there. If it's suspicious, we
trigger deeper scans. It intelligently routes the URL to optimize speed and cost.

Context-Aware Smart Routing

### Static & Cloaking Analysis

We simulate multiple visitors (Mobile Device, Desktop, GoogleBot) simultaneously. This forces
"Cloaking" attacks to reveal their true payloads targeting mobile victims.

Anti-Cloaking User-Agent Variance

### Visual & Behavioral

For high-stakes URLs, we launch a headless browser. We use **Computer Vision** to "see" the page
like a human, detecting fake login forms and drive-by downloads that code analysis misses.

Brand Logo Match Fake Login Detection

### The AI SOC Analyst

Finally, our LLM Synthesizer reviews all findings. It acts as a Senior Security Analyst, ignoring
noise and writing a human-readable explanation of *why* the site is dangerous.

## Common Questions About Link Safety

Everything you need to know about checking suspicious URLs and staying safe online.

How do I check if a link from a text or email is a scam?
Simply copy the link and paste it into the search bar above. **Do not click the link first.** URLert
uses an AI-powered investigation engine to "visit" the site for you in a secure environment. We
analyze the page layout, check for hidden redirects, and look for signs of brand impersonation (like
a fake bank login) so you don't have to risk your own device.
Why is URLert better than Google or VirusTotal for new links?
Traditional scanners rely on "blacklists"—which means they only catch a scam *after* people have
already been hurt. **URLert is built for zero-day threats.** Our AI acts like a human analyst: it
takes a real-time screenshot and reads the code of the site the second you scan it. This allows us
to detect brand-new scams and phishing pages hours or even days before the big databases catch up.
What does "Zero-Day Phishing" mean?
A "zero-day" attack is a brand-new scam created today that no one has seen yet. Scammers often
register new domains (like `yourbank-secure-login.top`) and send out thousands of texts before
Google or Microsoft can flag them. URLert's AI looks at the domain age, registration details (RDAP),
and visual cues to identify these "infant" threats instantly.
Can I safely scan shortened links (like bit.ly or t.co)?

quality. We look forward to assisting you with advice and providing you with premium components.

Valco, a custom metal fabrication company in Cleveland, Ohio, can deliver a wide range of metal
fasteners and parts. The cornerstone of our business is our signature line of Valco snap button
fasteners for telescoping tubing.

As a metal stamping company, we’ve spent over five decades refining and perfecting our snap button
fasteners. Valco works closely with customers to develop new models to fit specialized product
applications.

## Materials We Commonly Use for Metal Stamping

As a full-service manufacturing company, we want to ensure that we have the right metal stamping
supplies and tools to create your custom components. We offer a variety of materials so you can find
what you’re looking for. These materials include:
* Aluminum
* Brass
* Copper
* Monel
* Stainless steel
* Carbon steel
* High-strength steel
* And more

Regardless of the material you choose, your parts will be crafted with the utmost precision and
quality. We look forward to assisting you with advice and providing you with premium components.

## A Metal Stamping Company Located in Cleveland, Ohio

We have many ready-made fasteners, but we know that new products emerge or older ones need modified,
so as your metal stamping manufacturer we are here to manufacture your custom [metal stampings and
fasteners][82] with unbeatable quality.

### Our Operations: A Commitment to Quality

Valco is certified to [ISO 9001:2015][83] with design, and a special emphasis is placed on quality
throughout our entire metal manufacturing process. Visit our [operations page][84] to learn more
about our team, our approach, and how we can apply our metal parts manufacturing skills to your
products.

### Contact Us

How can we help you? Feel free to ask a question below or call us at **[440-237-0160][85]**.


 

[Metal stamping][Metal stamping]

 

## Our Production Capacity & Focus

Valco/ Valley Tool & Die operates a three-building manufacturing campus in Cleveland, Ohio,
specifically equipped for long-term production and high-volume fulfillment. While we welcome the
opportunity to help growing companies scale their operations, our facility is most efficiently
utilized for High annual volumes. By focusing on high-capacity automation, we can ensure competitive
per-part pricing and supply chain stability for our customers.

## FAQs on Metal Stamping

We strive to give our customers the best experience, and with that comes educating them on what they
can expect from our products and services. Below is a list of common questions metal stamping
companies receive, along with our answers and insights.

### What are the advantages of progressive die stamping?

By incorporating progressive die stamping into your operations, you can expect to reap a variety of
benefits, such as:
* Reduction of scrap metal
* Increased repeatability
* Faster setup
* Increased production speed
* Varied geometries for parts
* Capability to supply multiple rows of your part for each press stroke
* Lowered costs
* Reduced material handling
* Ability to maintain consistently close tolerances
* Higher press tonnage rate for heavier product materials

### What industries can benefit from metal stamping?

At Valco, we have the capabilities and extensive product development to work with a wide selection
of businesses. Our products and metal stamping services are utilized by [industries][86] such as
construction, child safety, health care, home care, retail, sporting goods, engineering and more!

### If I’m creating a custom part, what can I expect?

We stand out compared to other metal stamping companies, working with you every step of the process
to ensure we meet your product specifications. The first thing our team does is ask a variety of
questions to assess your needs, such as:
* How will the product be used?
* What are the dimensions needed for the part?
* What are the dimensions of any relevant components this part will operate in conjunction with?
* What are the load requirements?
* Will the part be exposed to saltwater environments?
* Are there any other relevant details to know about the product, its operations, or final use?

After we acquire this information, we can initiate the project review. We offer scalable options to
meet your specific volume requirements from specialized production runs to contracts of one million
pieces or more.
